info.title: Homie API
info.description: Household chore tracking backend. Routes tagged (stub) return deterministic previews and do not persist changes. Analytics samples are anchored to 2026-09-07.

post.description: Create a member without a household and issue a bearer token.
Authenticate using a JSON email/password body.

get.description: Return the authenticated member without password credentials.

post.description: Preview a household; does not persist or change membership.

get.description: Return sample data scoped to the authenticated household.

post.description: Preview joining with the demo invite code; membership is unchanged.
Preview a task without saving it.

patch.description: Preview changes to a sample task; omitted fields stay unchanged.

post.description: Preview an immutable event; manual input computes the start backwards. No write occurs.

get.description: Return paginated sample events, most recent first.
Sample per-member weekly minutes and shares, anchored to 2026-09-07.
Sample balance indices; a single contributing member yields null in real data.
Sample completion gaps and overdue flags.
Sample UTC weekday/hour buckets; omitted buckets have zero activity.
Execute a database connectivity check; return 503 if unavailable.
